column1: # written verbatim from the inline reply (runner 12 session_012eShPsWwW3quuzzUNV7nW5, H302, one Opus vision call, 29 Sept 2026)
# GROUP A: A closed loop with a long straight descender through it, and a small figure-8 loop sitting on top (phi-with-8 sign).
# GROUP B: An open "4"-shaped stroke with a vertical stem descending, and a "3"/B-shaped double bow attached on the right.
# GROUP C: An L-shaped mark: a tall ascender with a clubbed or looped head, curving down into a flat foot stroke to the right.
# GROUP D: Two tall f/long-s-like stems side by side, the left one crossed or footed by a short leftward stroke.
# GROUP E: A mark with a long diagonal stroke from lower left, ending in a heavy blob, that meets one or more upright stems (M/H-like).
